title: Provider-neutral federation metadata and mutation dispatch
summary: Federation owns neutral metadata construction and discovers external relations by capability/message shape rather than provider class. v0.71 similarly resolves the owning provider before mutation and returns SQLUNSUPPORTED for a real read-only relation instead of misleading file-table NOTFOUND.
invariants: Do not require an external provider to construct NoSQLServer implementation classes.
Do not special-case GeoPackage, Camera, Librarian, Algorithm Relation or other providers by class name.
Read-only external mutation is SQLUNSUPPORTED, not fake NOTFOUND.
Provider resolution is capability-shaped and additive.
